notes.title: EAV 1.10 UI Redesign
notes.notes:
[b]UI Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a Recipe Searcher, which can be found in the Tips and Hints, using T, the item icons can be clicked to show how to create the selected item and what can be crafted from it
[*] Remade multiple UI elements to better match the game's aesthetic.
[*] The Load button (outside the main menu) now functions correctly.
[*] Added a Recipe Finder, allowing you to search for item recipes, see where they are crafted, and check crafting times.
[*] Machines now display a progress bar, showing the time remaining until an item is crafted.
[*] Updated and expanded machine descriptions with more detailed information.
[*] Search bar in the Building Choosing Ui is now automatically in focus, so you can start searching right away
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Incinerator now properly burns items, causing items to move correctly
[*] Sound should now properly load without having to open the sound menu when playing to apply settings
[*] Selected Anit Aliasing method is now correctly highlighted in the settings menu
[*] Industrial Chassis can now properly be crafter using 3 basic machine chassis and 4 steel bars (recipe will probably change in the future as it is currently quite expensive without a way to fully automate wood stick and plant fiber)
[*] collision of all buildings should now be correctly set after finishing building without having to reload the save
[*] Fixed the name of the Tin Foundation 1m
[/list]

Some of the UI elements still use the old art style and will change over the next updates,
The next update will be the large Farming overhaul which might take a longer time to do,
much thanks to [u]Sebastian - TheNovice[/u] for reporting the bugs that were fixed in this patch

Enjoy the update, and thanks for your support!

notes.title: EAV 1.9 Constructed Together
notes.notes:
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added multiplayer
Launch the Game and go to the Multiplayer menu.
Select "Host Game" and choose your save file or start a new world.
Adjust your server settings
Select your desired save game
Click "Host Server", and the game will create a lobby.
Your friends can join by opening Steam, right-clicking your name in the friends list, and selecting "Join Game".


[*] Modular Armor can now be crafted in the Material Combining Unit.
Flight Enabled! Players wearing Modular Armor can now take to the skies.
[/list]

[b]Adjustments:[/b]
 casting chamber now works 4x faster

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Certain regions of the game now run up to 6x faster for a smoother experience, due to a fix of mesh/foliage culling

[*] Save File Fix: Resolved an issue where playtime would sometimes reset—your progress will now be correctly tracked.
[/list]

There are still a few minor bugs that I aim to fix in upcoming updates, such as items not always rendering correctly for clients on a server. (Gameplay-wise, everything still works; the items are just not visible.) The next update will likely include various bug fixes and adjustments, followed by the release of the Large [b]Farming Update[/b].

Have fun playing!

notes.title: EAV 1.8
notes.notes:
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fluid Bars Revamp: Updated the UI for fluid bars, they look much better now, and added support for rendering gases in fluid bars.
[*] Isolated Gas Pipes: Introduced dedicated pipes for handling gases, ensuring better separation and efficiency.
[*] Steam Turbine: Added a powerful new structure for generating energy from steam.
[*] Boiling Chamber: A new facility designed for controlled steam production.
[*] Electric Pump: Enabled the electric pump, making liquid management faster and more reliable.
[*] Research Expansion: Added a new research step, unlocking automated steam power for advanced energy solutions.
[/list]


[*] [b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Character Armor: Added a brand-new model for the character's armor, improving its visual
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Glowing Stairs: Resolved the issue where stairs appeared to glow. (if this issue still persist please write me a message on the steam discussions and upload a screenshot of the issue)
[*] Tin Plating: Fixed a bug that required crushed tin for tin plating instead of the intended tin ingots.
[*] Crafting Updates
[*] Solder Crafting: Solder can now properly be crafter by:
Combining crushed tin and crushed lead in the Fabricator.
Melting and casting the mixture in the Casting Chamber.
[/list]

I’ve made significant progress on multiplayer functionality, bringing it closer to completion. There are still a few things that need to be addressed before it’s ready for release, but it’s steadily approaching readiness. I hope to be able to release it in the near future :D

notes.title: EAV 1.7 FSR, Bug Fixes and more...
notes.notes:
[b]New Features:[/b]
[list]

[*][u]FSR3:[/u] The game now supports FidelityFX Super Resolution 3 (FSR3), AMD's cutting-edge upscaling technology. FSR3 delivers higher frame rates by generating additional frames between rendered frames, enhancing overall smoothness and responsiveness. This technology allows players to experience improved visual fidelity and performance even on less powerful hardware. Available settings can be adjusted to match your system’s capabilities for the best experience.
[*]Loading Screen: A loading screen has been added for a better transition experience.
[*]Steam Cloud Saves are now enabled, and should work
[*][b]New Items:[/b] Lead - Tin Blend, Solder, Lens, Laser Emitter

[/list]

[b]Adjustments:[/b]
[list]
[*]Removing a building connected to a conveyor now also removes the conveyor.
[*]Snap Points for Stone Foundations: Adjusted to improve building placement.
[*]Catwalk Unlock: Catwalks now unlock at a more appropriate stage in progression.
[*]Casting Easier to Use: Made placing casts into buildings easier by increasing collision size.
[*]Conveyor Highlight: Conveyors are now highlighted when targeted for interaction.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*][u][b]Conveyor Interaction: Fixed a long lasting issue which made conveyors annoying to interact, a bug which only occurred in the packaged game caused conveyors not to be interactable.[/b][/u]
[*]Fire Kiln Animation: Resolved an issue where the fire kiln sometimes wouldn’t play its animation.
[*]Rubber Sheet Unlock: Fixed an issue where rubber sheets were not unlocking properly.
[*]Sound and FSR Settings: Settings now persist correctly after restarting the game.
[*]Building Slots Rotation: Fixed slot switching when rotating buildings.
[*]Copper Structures Unlock: Resolved premature unlock of copper structures without proper research.
[*]Mechanical Hammer Research: Rubber sheets are no longer available before completing research.
[*]Axle Reload Bug: Fixed a major issue where unfinished axles, when reloaded and completed, caused components to connect to grid[0], potentially crashing the game.
[*]Unfinished Pipe Visuals: Fixed pipes appearing as finished when reloading.
[*]Backpack Inventory Bug: Fixed unlimited slots when loading a game with a backpack.
[*]Machine Chassis Icon: Corrected the icon displayed in the fabricator.
Dynamo Snapping Issue: Power connector and axle now snap to the correct position.
[/list]

notes.title: EAV 1.6 Building Mode Overhaul
notes.notes:
EAV 1.6 Building Mode Overhaul

[b]New Features[/b]

[list]

[b]Simple Building Mode:[/b]
[*]Quick Build: Instantly place buildings with a single click
[*]Fast Rotation: Rotate buildings using the scroll wheel

[b]Advanced Building Mode:[/b]
[*]Cluster Placement: Place rows or platforms of buildings in bulk, speeding up large-scale projects.
[*]Adjustment Mode: Precisely move buildings in any direction (or lower foundations to the desired level), allowing for perfect alignment.
[/list]

[b]Metal Structures:[/b] Added walls, foundations for all available metal types, allowing for customizable builds using available materials ( they can be researched after unlocking the material), and metal stairs and metal pillar

[b]Catwalk:[/b] Added catwalk elements, which neatly snap to each other allowing to navigate around the factory easier

[b]Middle Mouse Button Selection:[/b] Quickly reselect a previously placed building by pressing the middle mouse button while looking at it.

[b]Auto-Supply Materials:[/b] Automatically deposit required materials into buildings when available in your inventory.

[b]Custom Construction Materials:[/b] Animated material is shown when placing a building.


[b]Quality of Life Improvements:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b]HUD Stability:[/b] Fixed inconsistent building HUD sizes when scrolling through icons.
Item Return: Dismantling buildings with items now returns those items to the player’s inventory.
[*] [b]Power Consumption UI Fix:[/b] The power consumption display now disappears properly after stopping focus on a building.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Item Duplication Glitch: [/b]Resolved an issue where conveyor belts would duplicate items.
[*] [b]Texture Optimization:[/b] Decreased texture sizes for less critical assets, reducing game size and boosting performance.
[/list]

notes.title: EAV 1.5 Conveyor Update
notes.notes:
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Underground Belts: These belts function like regular conveyors but can bypass height obstacles, enabling more complex layouts and allowing for organization in tighter spaces.
[*] Splitter Interface: The splitter now has a configurable interface, allowing players to set output priority and filter items, adding control over item flow.
[*] Merger Interface: Similar to the splitter, the merger now lets players set the input priority, improving customization and item organization.
[*] Automatic Belt Support: After connecting a belt to the first snap point, supports are now placed automatically, making long belt placement more convenient.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life Improvements (QOL)[/b]
[list]
[*] Conveyor Belt Direction Preview: When placing a conveyor, a preview now shows the intended direction.
[*] Improved Snapping for Belts: Snapping mechanics for conveyor belts and underground belts have been made more intuitive, reducing placement frustration.
[*] Updated Storage Output Interface: The interface for storage output has been adjusted to align with the splitter interface for a consistent user experience.
[*] Conveyor Support Height Adjustment: The height of conveyor supports now matches most other outputs, aiding in streamlined design.
[*] Conveyor Placement "Glitch" Fix: Fixed a glitch that occurred when trying to place a conveyor belt.
[*] Item Throughput Specification: Conveyor belts now transport a set number of items per minute, making throughput clearer.
[/list]

[b]Performance Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] Custom Collision Channel for Items: Items now utilize a custom collision channel, improving collision handling and overall game performance.
[*] PoolingManager for Item Management: Implemented a PoolingManager to handle items efficiently, optimizing resource management and reducing lag.
[*] Spline and Spline Mesh Calculation in C++: Moved these calculations to C++ for faster loading and smoother belt placement performance.
[*] New System for Item Movement: Redesigned item movement to allow for more future customizations and better in-game performance.
[*] Simplified Item Class: The item class has been simplified, reducing overhead and enhancing performance.
[/list]

[b]General Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] New Versioning Format: The naming convention for conveyor generations has changed. Instead of "Gen," versions now use "V" (e.g., Conveyor V2 instead of Conveyor Gen.2).
[/list]

notes.title: ConstructEX Updates
notes.notes:
As we continue to grow and develop the game during Early Access (EA), I am excited to share the 
  approach to future updates and version numbering. I believe in keeping things transparent and 
  organized so that our community can easily track progress and understand what each update brings to 
  the table.

Version Naming Convention:
  Starting with our current build, EAV 1.0, all future updates will follow a clear and consistent naming 
  format:
    EAV MajorUpdate.MinorUpdate

For example, EAV 1.0 represents the first major update in Early Access. As we release additional updates, 
  both major and minor, you'll see the version numbers change accordingly. This structure will allow 
  players to quickly understand the significance of an update based on its version number.

Major Updates will introduce substantial new features, systems, or game mechanics. These are the 
  updates that will push the game closer to its full release.

Minor Updates will focus on smaller changes like bug fixes, performance improvements, and adjustments 
  to existing systems.
Why This Matters:
  I know how important it is for our players to stay informed and be part of the journey. With this clear 
  versioning system, you’ll always know what level of changes are coming and what to expect from each 
  update. Whether it’s a massive content drop or an improvement to make your gameplay smoother, you’ll 
  be able to track our progress as we work towards the full release.

Stay tuned for more details on upcoming updates, and as always, thank you for your support during Early Access! Your feedback helps shape the future of the game!

Let’s make this game the best it can be!
